label: HTTP server
description: The server that answers this tree's http triggers. A project's startup list names `listen` to open it: nothing opens a port on its own, so a tree that does not ask to listen does not. The routes are the http triggers themselves -- this operation names none of them.

listen.description: Open the port and answer every http trigger in the tree until the process stops. Answers what it opened, so a startup report says the port and how many routes it carries.

port.description: the port to listen on; absent: the @http plugin's settings.port, and 8080 when that is absent too

routes.description: how many http triggers it answers
